verdict.rationale: The docs describe AI-driven browser agents that start from a single API call and run live in cloud sessions, with built-in Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Grok and BrowserUse agents. HyperAgent's `page.ai()` takes a multi-step natural-language goal, as in the 'search for flights… select the cheapest option' example, so the core of handing over a goal and having it run end to end is documented. missing for 10: explicit documentation of form-filling and click-through flow handling, reliability or completion details for multi-step tasks, and independent or hands-on corroboration of end-to-end task success.
